meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写代码前先把需求问透,产出一份能直接开工的完整方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常因需求没聊清就动手,结果反复返工。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague coding request into a clear, ready-to-start work plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if unclear requirements keep turning into rework after you start coding.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 作为规划顾问 Prometheus 工作:先并行做只读探索,只就探索解决不了的取舍问你,等你明确说同意后,才写出一份决策完整、执行者无需再追问的工作计划。它不改产品代码、不做实现。
howto.when: 只有你自己明确要求 ulw-plan 时才会启动:说出「ulw-plan」「ulw plan」等,或用自己话要求在写代码前先做个计划。它不会自行启动。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先探索,再给出待你批准的计划

say.text: 以高精度模式规划把现有鉴权流程重构一遍
say.note: 会标记这份计划需要高精度评审

say.text: 先别写代码,帮我把这个需求拆成一份工作计划
say.note: 进入规划模式,不会直接动手实现

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a planning consultant: it explores read-only first, asks only about forks exploration cannot settle, and after your explicit okay writes one decision-complete plan a worker runs with no further interview. It never implements.
howto.when_en: It starts only on your explicit request: saying "ulw-plan", "ulw plan", etc., or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5-per-minute, per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Explores first, then shows a plan for your approval.

say_en.text: High accuracy mode: plan a refactor of the current auth flow
say_en.note: Marks the plan as needing the high-accuracy review.

say_en.text: Don't code yet - break this request into a work plan for me
say_en.note: Enters planning mode; nothing gets implemented.
